description.p: LibrePods brings AirPods features that are normally limited to Apple devices to Linux.

ul.li: Noise control modes: switch between noise cancellation, transparency and adaptive
Ear detection: pause and resume playback when you take your AirPods out or put them in
Battery status: accurate levels for each earbud and the case
Conversational awareness: lower the volume automatically when you speak
Tray icon, COSMIC panel applet and a command-line interface
